content:
alex: Starting a scoped TF apply for tenant-cutover tomorrow night 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. Modules: module.network, module.iam. Plan validated in staging. Need final sign-off on provider pin, rollback criteria, and deploy-bot schedule. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC. @sam @maria

maria: +1. Checklist: tfstate lock, backup snapshot (s3://infra-state/backups/latest), preflight smoke tests (http health endpoints), routing sanity, KMS key availability. Added release notes draft: https://docs.internal/releases/tenant-cutover-20260402. We'll do 5% shadow traffic for 15m before full shift.

deploy-bot: scheduled: terraform plan passed (sha: f9b2c). Queue position: 3. Auto-apply disabled; manual confirm required. Plan summary:
```
Plan: 8 to add, 3 to change, 1 to destroy
Modules affected: module.network, module.iam
Provider: registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws ~> 4.70
```

sam: proposal: pin provider to 4.70.0 and module tag v2.1.3 for prod. Command I'll run for apply:
```
TF_VAR_env=prod terraform apply -var-file=prod.tfvars -target=module.network -parallelism=50
```
Also will run `aws s3 cp s3://infra-state/backup/latest snapshot-20260402` before apply.

ryan: Rollback criteria (we should be explicit):
- 5xx rate >2% service-wide sustained over 10m
- Route table propagation failures or >10% rejected connections in VPCs
- IAM role attach errors for more than 2 hosts
If any hit, immediate rollback to previous module tag v2.1.2 via:
```
terraform apply -var 'module_version=v2.1.2' -auto-approve
```
Logging & pager will be triggered on alert.

kai: Also: confirm KMS key policy allows new principal, and ensure service account `svc-cutover` has iam:PassRole. Added runbook: https://runbooks.internal/tenant-cutover. I'll be oncall during window.

alex: OK locking this in. @deploy-bot please hold for manual ok at T-15m. Who's on monitor? @maria you on metrics, @ryan on networking, @kai on IAM/KMS. Preflight smoke target list: auth, edge-proxy, egress-gw. :eyes:

maria: I'm on metrics. Will create a dashboard snapshot and post link before T-10m. :thumbsup:

sam: I'll perform the apply and keep terminal logs in the release channel. Will tag the commit and push release notes after success.
